about: The one list of the screenshots: the website's set and the App Store's, both from it (SCREENSHOTS.md).
shots are in the order they are taken (the circuits scene leaves the national map selected, so it comes last;
a dry run needs no flight running, so it follows a scene that cancels one). steps are the screenshot tour's
gesture after the scene is up, by device kind ('all' for both): tap:<accessibility identifier>,
tapLabel:<text>, tapTab:<n>, wait:<identifier>, pinchMap:<scale>, cardAtFoot, swipeUp:<points>, sleep:<s>.
mask: by device, the areas that change at every capture (a running timer), blanked before the comparison, in
points of the device's portrait screen [x, y, width, height], and maskWhy, what they are (the report says it).
settle: seconds of stillness before the screenshot (3 by
default; the Cockpit's map frames itself and its check slot settles for about 20 s after the launch).
statusBar: false for a shot whose top the app draws (the dry run's band): the run doesn't wait for a clean status
bar there. appstore: the slot number; website: published on the site.

appstore.about: Full size, PNG without alpha; JPEG 95 (4:4:4) for an image over maxBytes, as App Store Connect refuses about 5 MB.

website.about: public/assets/screenshot/v6/<device>/<key>.jpg in English, v6/<lang>/<device>/<key>.jpg in French and German.

shots.label: The Cockpit in cruise
shots.what: The Cockpit in cruise with a route (LSGC NEXT), Fuel quantity framed (4/5), the strip lit. iPhone: the list dragged until the current card ends at its foot.

shots.label: V-SPEEDS
shots.what: V-SPEEDS open over the Cockpit: the table on the iPad (its chip), the list on the iPhone (a tap on GS).

shots.label: The Cockpit on its map
shots.what: The Cockpit on its map: LSGC next, the aircraft on the LSZQ to LSGC leg.
shots.maskWhy: the flight timer, the leg timer, the track vector's minute marks

shots.label: The iPhone on its side
shots.what: The iPhone on its side: the Cockpit's column, the map at full height.

shots.label: Today, with the day’s flight
shots.what: Today, with today's flight at 14:00 as the next flight.

shots.label: A followed flight
shots.what: A followed flight LSZQ to LFSB on the next 1 August, on its own page.

shots.label: Preparing a flight
shots.what: The same flight, its NOTAMs and airspace block open (the airspace activity per country, the DABS in words): unfolded on the iPad, its sheet on the iPhone.

shots.label: The route editor
shots.what: The route editor: Geneva to Samedan over the ICAO chart, the profile, the leg table, the conflicts count. iPhone: a gentle pinch so LSGG and LSZS fit.
shots.maskWhy: the iPhone's map: MapKit shows another set of icons after the pinch; the iPad's route editor checks the map

shots.label: A flight in the logbook
shots.what: Vol d'Alpes in the logbook: track, altitude profile.

shots.label: Closing out a flight
shots.what: Vol d'Alpes (a real flight) in CLOSE, the red close-your-ATC-flight-plan card.

shots.label: A dry run on the ground
shots.what: The guided dry run held on its first final at LSZQ: the coach's Try a go-around card over the card that chooses the landing. About three minutes after launch the autopilot holds there.
shots.maskWhy: the timer, and the strip's figures at the moment the autopilot holds

shots.label: Traffic circuits on the map
shots.what: Plan › Map close in on LSZQ: its traffic circuit at 2900 ft, the W and E arrival sectors, runway 07/25.
